headline: A compact command center for the Royals season

latest_prospect_update.name: Blake Mitchell
latest_prospect_update.note: Most obvious remaining minor-league prospect to track; catcher development and power/patience are the main signals. Recent line: .259 / .333 / .407.

nightly_recap: The Royals lost to the Minnesota Twins, KC 2, MIN 3. Seth Lugo led the night, working 6.0 innings with 1 earned runs, 2 strikeouts and 2 walks. Carter Jensen supplied the loudest Royals contact at 106.6 mph.
